round1_resolution.finding: major: time-like clause in REPORT finding 1
round1_resolution.notes: The finding now covers l.794-795 (space-like) and l.797-800 (light-like) only. It says explicitly that the time-like bullet l.788-791 is not affected: central holonomy is elliptic by l.693-694 and OQ-113 (d). Checked true against the tex. l.799 does claim 'the link L is a parabolic RP1-circle', and l.795 claims 'L is a hyperbolic RP1-circle', both unconditionally. With trivial Gamma_p-holonomy, linkCover(f t) = linkCover t for all t. linkCover identifies t and t' iff t' - t is in 2Z (linkCover_eq_linkCover_iff), so f - id is a continuous 2Z-valued function, hence constant, and f = delta^(2n) with n >= 1 since D is increasing. Then toPSL f = 1, so f is neither hyperbolic (trSq = 4) nor parabolic: PSL2.IsParabolic (RP1Circles.lean:982) requires g != 1. The claim that Gamma_p has no element acting as -id at p in dS2 or on the boundary of H2 is right: -id on the Lorentzian plane p-perp reverses time orientation, and at a null p, Gamma_p is unipotent. GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.even_of_nonneg, at every p with minkQ p >= 0, formalizes the consequence: no ray is sent to its antipode, so the degree is even. 'Real angle 4 pi n' matches the hub convention: angle(delta) = 2 pi (OQ-113 (a)), and hasRealAngle_link gives 4 pi. With non-trivial holonomy the space-like bullet is proved (isHyperbolic_of_deSitter, standard axioms), and the light-like one is stated (isParabolic_of_null, tagged sorry). So 'with non-trivial holonomy' is a sufficient correction for the space-like bullet, and proved sufficient modulo that sorry for the light-like one. The REPORT says so.

round1_resolution.finding: minor 1: dS2 counterexample is a regular point
round1_resolution.notes: The REPORT and the docstring at l.1993-1997 now call regular_not_isHyperbolic the regular link and name the n-fold cyclic cover of l(p), n >= 2, as the singular counterexample, argued and not built. That counterexample is valid: its charts are local sections of the covering S1 -> l(p), so the transitions are the identity, which lies in Gamma_p, and its developing map is the covering. regular_not_isHyperbolic has no hypothesis on p, so together with not_isParabolic_delta_sq it is also a Lean counterexample at a null p for l.797-800.
